title: Countable basis for free electromagnetic fields
summary: Polychromatic electromagnetic fields are typically expanded as integrals over monochromatic fields, such as plane waves, multipolar fields, or Bessel beams. However, monochromatic fields do not belong to the Hilbert space of free Maxwell fields, since their norms diverge. Moreover, the continuous frequency integrals involved in such expansions complicate the treatment of light--matter interactions via the scattering operator.
